text:
It is truly heartwarming to witness the cinematic miracle where teenagers, burdened by the crushing weight of algebra and awkward crushes, suddenly remember they are also Broadway stars. Because nothing says "coming of age" like interrupting a heartfelt confession to break into synchronized jazz hands. We have all learned that the solution to a broken heart or a failing grade is not therapy or study, but rather a well-timed tap routine that somehow resolves all societal issues. Why engage in the messy, unchoreographed reality of human emotion when you can simply out-dance your trauma? It is a beautiful simplification of existence, where the only thing standing between you and happiness is a lack of rhythm.

As for the primary material of a candle, it is, of course, wax. Specifically, paraffin wax, which is derived from petroleum, or sometimes beeswax, which is derived from bees. It is the fuel that burns, providing light, much like the fleeting illumination of a teen movie’s moral lesson before the credits roll.
